timing_methodology.fcfs: decision (fcfs_order) + allocation (building the allocator requests + allocate_batch)
timing_methodology.aashray: decision (scores + order) + allocation (building the allocator requests + allocate_batch)
timing_methodology.milp: model build + solver (the validated run_scenario timing)
timing_methodology.excluded: dataset loading/generation, Python start-up, warm-up, writing and loading each scenario's inventory file (the existing allocator only loads warehouses from a file), order verification, result extraction, file writing
timing_methodology.warm_up: the first 3 scenarios are run once for every method before timing starts; those warm-up runs are not recorded
timing_methodology.execution: single process; scenarios in dataset order; within each scenario FCFS, then AASHRAY, then MILP
